notes.title: Multiple Daily GoldenCube Drops!
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome to ICE[i]![/i] 2.0![/h2]

[h2]New Changes:

1. more stable inventory system.
2. GoldenCubes can be won either by playing ICE[i]![/i] or through timed drops![/h2]

[h3]*GoldenCubes will be included in ICE! wins and in-game drops! The game will show you when you win a GoldenCube with a notification screen.

**sell your GoldenCube on the Steam Marketplace for $10, and we'll buy it![/h3]
